test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All Fruits are Vegetables.

II. All Vegetables are Almond.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Vegetables are Fruits.

II. All Almond are Vegetables.

III. Some Fruits are Almond.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

solution:
Given Statements:

I. All Fruits are Vegetables.

II. All Vegetables are Almond.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac761afca5f74ae4e823cddc7cb6ec3bf99c3ea996e925d3cc640cf026ed52a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Vegetables are Fruits - True (All Fruits are Vegetables, it means some Vegetables are Fruits).

II. All Almond are Vegetables - False (Because, All Vegetables are Almond, so all Almond are Vegetables can be possible only).

III. Some Fruits are Almond - True (Because, All Fruits are Vegetables and All Vegetables are Almond, so Some Fruits are Almond)

So, Both conclusions I and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
